prompt: Implement dependency_stages(deps). Given a dict mapping each job name to an iterable of prerequisite names, return a list of tuples for topological stages. Each stage contains all jobs whose prerequisites completed in earlier stages, sorted lexicographically. Ignore repeated prerequisites. Empty input returns []. Raise ValueError for unknown prerequisite names or any cycle. Do not mutate deps.

Implement daily_counters(rows). Given (day, name, delta) tuples, return a new dict keyed by day, each containing a dict of per-name summed deltas. day and name are nonempty strings. delta must be a plain integer excluding bool. Include a name if its sum is zero; retain negative sums. Raise ValueError for invalid fields. Days are opaque labels.

Implement collapse_runs(values, maximum). Given a list of strings and positive plain integer maximum, run-length encode consecutive equal strings as (value, count) tuples. A run longer than maximum is split into maximum-sized chunks followed by any remainder. Keep order, do not mutate inputs, and allow empty strings. Raise ValueError for invalid maximum or any non-string value, even when no run has been emitted.

Implement transfer_stock(inventory, moves). Apply ordered moves (source, target, quantity) to a copy of inventory. Keys are nonempty strings, balances are nonnegative plain ints, quantity is a positive plain int. Source and target must be distinct existing keys. Reject insufficient source stock at that step. Return the updated dict and leave the original intact even on errors. Raise ValueError for invalid fields, unknown keys or insufficient stock.
